select o.order_id, o.redemption_code, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.product_name, o.cover_url, o.points_cost, o.create_time, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = o.user_id) as user_name from learning_shop_order o
and exists (select 1 from sys_user u where u.user_id = o.user_id and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%'))
and o.product_name like concat('%', #{productName}, '%')
and o.redemption_code = #{redemptionCode}
order by o.order_id desc

select o.order_id, o.redemption_code, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.product_name, o.cover_url, o.points_cost, o.create_time from learning_shop_order o where o.user_id = #{userId} order by o.order_id desc
